full_judgment:
2. The plaintiff claimed pattan of the suit land from the Estate of the Zamindars in 1331 BS. The plaintiffs father possessed the suit land on payment of rents and on receipt of dakhilas. Upon the death of his father the plaintiff became the sole owner of the suit land. Defendant No. 1 being the Tahshilder of the said Estate created certain documents for the purpose of grabbing the suit land illegally. 

 3. Defendant No. 1 contended that the pattan in favour of the plaintiffs' father is false. One Profullah Kumar Mitra took pat tan of the suit land in 1351 BS. Defendant No. 1 took pattan of the same from the said Profullah in 1357 BS and since then defendant No. 1 had been owning and possessing the suit land.
